Menu.description: A menu on UI SDK: arrows, Home, End and typing move the highlight, Enter runs, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.

Root.description: Holds the open state and runs the actions; it renders no element of its own.

onAction.description: Called with the value of the plain item that ran. Checkbox and radio items report through their own handlers.

open.description: Controls the open state; pair it with onOpenChange.

modal.description: true: while open, page scroll locks and the page is inert. pointer: outside presses only close. false: the page stays usable.

loop.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first; unset, they do.

Trigger.description: The button that opens the menu; it renders a kit Button.

variant.description: The Button variant; unset, it is the Button default, secondary.

size.description: The Button size; unset, it is the Button default, m.

disabled.description: Stops the trigger from opening the menu; a disabled trigger cannot take focus.

Popup.description: Positioner and popup in one part; it opens below the trigger, aligned to its start, in the browser's top layer.

container.description: The element, or a ref to it, the popup mounts into instead of in place. It still opens in the top layer.

side.description: The trigger's side the popup opens on; unset, bottom. It flips when there is no room.

align.description: The popup's alignment along that side; unset, start.

sideOffset.description: Extra px on top of the kit's CSS offset between the trigger and the popup.

collisionPadding.description: Kit-set: the 8px gap the popup keeps from the window's edges, the Dialog's gutter.

finalFocus.description: What takes focus on close: a selector, an element, a function, or none. Needed when an action removes the trigger.

Item.description: An action whose text is the label typeahead matches; a disabled one stays focusable and never runs.

value.description: Passed to the Root's onAction when the item runs.

disabled.description: Shows the item muted; the arrow keys and pointer still reach it, and it never runs or closes the menu.

shortcut.description: A key hint like mod+d, shown at the item's end and set as aria-keyshortcuts. It binds no key unless the menu is data-driven.

onSelect.description: Runs when the item is chosen; preventDefault keeps the menu open and skips onAction. A returned Promise marks it pending.

label.description: The text typeahead matches, when it should differ from the item's visible text.

CheckboxItem.description: An item that switches one option on and off; a check marks it while on, and the menu stays open.

value.description: Identifies the item in the Root's onCheckedChange.

checked.description: Whether the item is on, when controlled; pair it with onCheckedChange.

defaultChecked.description: Whether the item starts on, when it is not controlled.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the next on or off state when the item is toggled.

disabled.description: Shows the item muted; it stays focusable and never toggles.

RadioGroup.description: Radio items that share one value; name it with a GroupLabel, and aria-label when the label is not inside.

value.description: The chosen value, when controlled; pair it with onValueChange.

defaultValue.description: The value chosen at first, when the group is not controlled.

onValueChange.description: Called with the next value when another item is chosen.

RadioItem.description: One choice in a RadioGroup; a dot marks the chosen one, and the menu stays open.

value.description: The value the group takes when this item is chosen.

disabled.description: Shows the item muted; it stays focusable and is never chosen.

Group.description: Groups related items under a GroupLabel.

GroupLabel.description: The muted heading of a group; UI SDK names the group by it.

Separator.description: A hairline between groups of items; it takes no focus.

Sub.description: A submenu that renders no element of its own, holding a SubTrigger and a SubPopup.

SubTrigger.description: The item that opens its submenu; a chevron at its end points toward it, mirrored in right-to-left text.

disabled.description: Shows the item muted; it stays focusable and never opens its submenu.

SubPopup.description: The submenu's popup, beside its SubTrigger; it stays inside its parent popup.

collisionPadding.description: Kit-set: the 8px gap the popup keeps from the window's edges, the Dialog's gutter.

useWhen: A short list of actions on one object, opened from a button.
Settings that change in place: on and off items, or one choice from a few.
Related actions grouped under one trigger so the page stays quiet.

avoidWhen.text: The person picks a value for a form field.
One action is the main thing on the page.
The content is a form or free text, not a list of commands.

a11y: Give Trigger visible text; an icon-only trigger needs an aria-label.
Name each RadioGroup with a GroupLabel, or an aria-label when the label sits outside it.
Show a result for every action: a closed menu leaves no sign that an item ran.
